Input image 1 is the approved Transport Miniature World composition/camera reference. Preserve its matte hand-painted miniature model materials, warm stone buildings, navy roofs, bright soft daylight, coherent elevated three-quarter perspective, exact shared 16:9 canvas and spatial registration (1672 by 941 reference). No text, UI, logos, people, labels, watermark, white frame or baked checkerboard. Create ONLY the MIDDLE-GROUND stage layer with genuine alpha transparency above its silhouette. Retain the original station and depot at left, central back-row houses, broad curving road, complete empty railway track on left, central quiet sandy square, harbour water and complete quay on right, all lower ground to the bottom edge. REMOVE the train, yellow bus, ferry, airplane and ALL their cast shadows; reconstruct complete unobstructed rail sleepers, asphalt, pavement and water behind them. REMOVE the entire sky, all clouds, distant hills/cliffs/sea beyond the town, distant airfield/runway/hangar (they belong in the separate background layer), overhead foreground branches/leaves and nearest bottom-edge bushes. Those removed upper/background areas must be truly transparent. The remaining middle ground must reach every lower canvas edge as in the reference, except removed foreground foliage is replaced with complete clean ground, never holes in road or water. Keep all buildings, track, road and quay in the reference positions, not isolated floating props, not a newly framed scene. Do not add any vehicle, cloud, foreground branch or distant landscape. Native canvas stays full wide reference frame; do not tightly crop to content.
